scope: CalBench opt-in evaluation; production active unchanged

prompt_retry_policy.retry_trigger: request/transport failure, empty or unfinished output; MS/action budget validation failure; native semantic/parser retries otherwise unchanged
prompt_retry_policy.restart: only the failed prompt at the current game position, immediately; no whole-case or previous-stage replay
prompt_retry_policy.action_retry: keep the accepted MS and retry only action with the same remaining cap
prompt_retry_policy.budget: accepted MS + accepted action share configured cap (primary4096); failed-generation retries add fully recorded compute beyond that cap
prompt_retry_policy.exhausted: after two failed attempts abort only this case and continue remaining cases
prompt_retry_policy.report: one case result; preserve every physical prompt attempt, errors and all costs; incomplete utility remains missing

contract.usage_contract: required nonnegative integer completion_tokens from provider; includes reasoning tokens when provider counts them in completion_tokens; do not add reasoning tokens twice
contract.budget_failure: retry only failed stage once on invalid/missing usage, exceeded cap or exhausted MS budget; abort case after exhaustion without executing failed output
contract.budget_scope: accepted MS/action output cap; discarded failed generations add fully recorded cost, not matched FLOPs or input tokens
contract.ms_memory: no independent MS history; native final assistant responses remain in native history
contract.request_layout: native messages byte-for-byte unchanged; append separate user MS prompt; continue exact prefix with actual assistant MS response then user action prompt
contract.persistence: temporary stage messages never mutate native history; return only final action response to original client for its original persistence policy
contract.analysis_failure: retry only failed MS prompt once; no failed output appended; if both fail abort case and continue suite
contract.action_failure: retry only failed action prompt once with accepted MS unchanged; native parser/decision retry retained
contract.seed_policy: action uses original native seed sequence; MS uses SHA256(native seed:ms)
contract.privacy: only native visible messages; MS is private and never executed

resolved_transport.context_policy: no adapter truncation; server rejects oversized requests
resolved_transport.context_capacity: see server_commands; external API capacity otherwise 未记录
